description: This is a FastAPI router implementation managing connector-based operations, including listing connectors, retrieving metadata, search, create, listing projects/spaces, and LLM tool proxy endpoints. It defines multiple API endpoints, request models, external dependencies, and incorporates rate limiting, auditing, and error handling.

classes.name: SearchBody
classes.description: Pydantic model for search request data with provider, query, tenant_id, connection_id, limit, cursor, extra.

classes.name: CreateBody
classes.description: Pydantic model for create request data with provider, tenant_id, connection_id, kind, payload, extra.

classes.name: ToolInvokeBody
classes.description: Pydantic model for LLM tool invocation with provider, tool, query, kind, payload, tenant_id, connection_id, limit, cursor.

methods.name: list_connectors(ctx: TenantContext = Depends(get_tenant_context))
methods.description: Returns a list of registered connectors and their descriptors.

methods.name: get_connector_metadata( provider: str = Path(..., description="Connector key, e.g. 'jira' or 'confluence'"), ctx: TenantContext = Depends(get_tenant_context), )
methods.description: Fetches metadata for a specific connector provider, including capabilities and auth strategies.

methods.name: SearchResponse proxy_search(body: SearchBody, ctx: TenantContext = Depends(get_tenant_context), request: Request = None)
methods.description: Proxies a generic search request to the specified provider's search implementation.

methods.name: CreateResponse proxy_create(body: CreateBody, ctx: TenantContext = Depends(get_tenant_context), request: Request = None)
methods.description: Proxies a create entity request to the specified provider.

methods.name: MetadataResponse list_projects( provider: str = Path(..., description="Connector key."), tenant_id: str = Query(..., description="Tenant id."), connection_id: str = Query(..., description="Connection id."), ctx: TenantContext = Depends(get_tenant_context), request: Request = None, )
methods.description: Lists projects from a provider by delegating to provider metadata (resource='projects').

methods.name: MetadataResponse list_spaces( provider: str = Path(..., description="Connector key."), tenant_id: str = Query(..., description="Tenant id."), connection_id: str = Query(..., description="Connection id."), ctx: TenantContext = Depends(get_tenant_context), request: Request = None, )
methods.description: Lists spaces from a provider via metadata (resource='spaces').

methods.name: llm_tools_discovery()
methods.description: Provides a list of available LLM tools and usage instructions.

methods.name: llm_tool_proxy(body: ToolInvokeBody, ctx: TenantContext = Depends(get_tenant_context))
methods.description: Acts as a proxy for LLM tools, routing invocation to provider-specific operations based on the tool type.
